description: Permissions for a detached sidebar panel's webview. Without an entry here a webview has NO permissions at all — not even `core:event` — so its `listen`/`emit` calls reject, it never hears the workbench's context broadcast, and it can never tell the workbench to dock it back; that is the same bug the editor window's capability file documents. Scoped like the git and editor windows': `core:event` and the window controls the panel draws in its own title bar, plus the dialog plugin for the file tree's own pickers and confirmations. No `fs:*` — the file tree reads through this app's own Rust commands, not the fs plugin — and no `core:webview:*`, because a panel never spawns child webviews.
